1.d4 f5 2.Nc3 Nf6 3.g4.strategy: Throws the pawn forward without support: g4 is attacked by the f-pawn and the knight and defended by nothing, so Black simply wins it. White hopes for open lines against Black's king, but the compensation is slight.
1.d4 f5 2.Nc3 Nf6 3.g4.name: Dutch Defence: Spielmann Gambit
